nodes.line: You didn't see me. I didn't see you. The shrimp saw us both but they're not talking.

options.label: Ask about salvage
options.response: There's a wreck off the delta with a hold full of Flock equipment. Manifest says 'agricultural.' It is not agricultural.

options.label: Ask about a routing cover sheet
options.response: Things wash up on this dock. Paper washes up too. One cover sheet, salt-stained but valid. The tide provides.

options.label: Mention the Form 27-B you are definitely not filling in
options.response: Forms drift in with the tide. I make sure they drift back out. Consider it filed. Or not filed. Whichever is safer.

options.label: Report in after orientation
options.response: The delta hears things. You're cleared for ladder work. The mosquitoes are also cleared. For you.

options.label: Ask about manifests
options.response: Every crate has a manifest. Every manifest has a lie in it. I collect the lies.

options.label: Move along
options.response: Tide's turning. Good time to not be here.

nodes.line: You bring it up quiet, you sell it quieter, and you never learn what it was. That's the whole job.

options.label: Agree to the terms
options.response: Then we have an understanding. The buoy's marked. The current does the rest.

options.label: Ask what the equipment does
options.response: It watches. That's all Flock equipment ever does. Now stop asking before someone writes it down.

nodes.line: The pelicans are wired. I seen one blink in morse. Nobody believes me but the shrimp know. The shrimp always know.

options.label: Ask about the pelicans
options.response: Wired. Every one. You can tell by the way they don't blink at the same time. That's the giveaway.

options.label: Ask what the shrimp know
options.response: Everything. They just lack the vocabulary. I'm working on a dictionary.

options.label: Ask about a HONK DAMPENER
options.response: The platform man traded it to me, yeah. Silences honks. I tried it on a goose. Goose honked anyway, quieter, like it was embarrassed. Take it. The shrimp don't want it.

options.label: Back away from the dock
options.response: You mark my words. One day a pelican's gonna file a report on you.

nodes.line: THE HURRICANES AREN'T WEATHER! They're ATMOSPHERIC SWEEP PROTOCOLS! Every storm is a REGIONAL MEMORY WIPE with wind branding! I live in a DRAIN! Concrete attenuates the sweep frequency! YOU CAN'T CALIBRATE A CULVERT!

options.label: Ask about the sweeps
options.response: Category 1 is a SOFT PURGE! Category 5 is a FULL FACTORY RESET! They name them after PEOPLE so you'll feel BAD about the telemetry! HURRICANE LAURA READ MY DREAMS!

options.label: Mention the fisherman's pelicans
options.response: LaRue is CLOSE! The pelicans aren't wired, they're ANTENNAS FOR THE TIDE GAUGES! Every gauge is a LISTENING POST with a float! I DISCONNECTED THREE! The tide KEPT REPORTING!

options.label: Ask about the bucket
options.response: IT'S A BAIT BUCKET WITH A COPPER LINING! Saltwater conducts, copper SHIELDS! The bucket stays ON during sweeps! My minnows are UNSCANNED! THEY'RE THE LAST FREE MINNOWS IN THE GULF!

options.label: Climb out of the outfall
options.response: STAY BELOW THE STORM SURGE LINE! The barometers SHARE NOTES! It's in the WEATHER SERVICE CHARTER!

nodes.line: THE EVACUATION ROUTES! 'Follow the blue signs!' WHY DO THE SIGNS NEED MY LICENSE PLATE?! Every contraflow lane is a CONVEYOR! THINK ABOUT IT! THINK!

options.label: Ask about the signs
options.response: The signs FLASH when you pass! FLASH! WHEN! YOU! PASS! That's not a reflector, that's a RECEIPT!

options.label: Nod, waterlogged
options.response: YOU GET IT! STAY LOW! The herons down here are CLEAN! I checked their LEG BANDS! ALL BLANK! I CHECKED EVERY ONE!

nodes.line: I weave surveillance footage into shrimp nets and hang them in the chapel. The congregation calls it 'haunting.' The diocese calls it 'actionable.'

options.label: Ask about the nets
options.response: Every knot is a frame of footage. When the net moves in the wind, the images play. The sea is the only screen they can't subpoena.

options.label: Ask who funds it
options.response: A Flock coastal beautification grant. They pay for art that 'engages with safety themes.' I engage. Oh, how I engage.

options.label: Ask about the chapel
options.response: Deconsecrated in '09. The cameras re-consecrated it in their way. Every steeple needs an eye.

options.label: Leave the chapel
options.response: The installation runs until the tide takes it. That is the review I care about.

nodes.line: I dipped the last net in phosphorescent algae. At night the cameras can watch themselves glow. Three were 'decommissioned.' That was the vernissage.

options.label: Ask about the next piece
options.response: Buoys. A choir of buoys, singing the license plates of every boat in the marina. The water remembers what the forms forget.

options.label: Nod, respectfully damp
options.response: Exactly. Rust is the only honest critic left. You understand the work.

nodes.line: Back in my day we didn't have weather apps. We had knees. My knee could call a storm three days out and never once asked for my location.

options.label: Ask about his boat
options.response: Bought her in '81 for the price of a good rifle. Best decision I ever made. You people lease kayaks. Lease! A kayak!

options.label: Ask about the pier cameras
options.response: Love 'em. Caught a manatee on mine Thursday. Emailed the footage to the whole marina. The manatee did not respond.

options.label: Ask about the last hurricane
options.response: Sat on my porch through the whole thing with a flashlight and a cooler. You kids evacuate for a strong breeze. My porch is older than your car and it's still standing.

options.label: Leave Earl to his dock
options.response: You kids just don't know honest bait. My tackle box is older than you and every lure in it still works.
